About.mainTitle: WE SUPPORT YOU IN THE SUCCESS OF YOUR INTERNATIONAL SOURCING AND TRADING PROJECTS!
About.history: CL INTERNATIONAL is a strategic company located in the heart of the Aix-en-Provence business hub. Founded in 1999 by Jimmy and Carina LIM, the company is built on over 25 years of "Business experience."
About.evolution: From the beginning, we have supported the distribution of diverse products (disposable tableware, industrial valves, wines & spirits...). To meet our clients' demands for sourcing optimization in Asia, we deployed a specialized sourcing unit backed by a solid professional network.
About.mission: Today, CL INTERNATIONAL implements international trading to meet our clients' procurement needs with flexible and adaptable services, from design to final delivery.
About.flexibility: A constantly expanding range of products to meet specific and modular requests.

wine.title: Wines & Spirits
wine.desc: Leader in supporting vineyards for export to Asia and North America. We don't just transport bottles; we secure the value of your vintages and the integrity of your brand image internationally.

items.logistics: Thermo-Control Logistics: Use of insulated containers (Reefer) and thermal shock solutions to preserve organoleptic qualities.
items.customs: Customs Engineering: Complex management of excise duties, import licenses, and local labeling compliance.
items.protection: Appellation Protection: Active monitoring against counterfeiting and legal securing of domain names and trademarks in target markets.

industry.title: Industry, Construction & Energy
industry.desc: Sourcing of critical components and structural materials meeting the strictest European safety standards. We bridge the gap between Western engineering and Asian productive power.

items.molds: Machining & Molds: Engineering of high-performance steel injection molds and precision CNC machining (Aluminum, Stainless Steel, Titanium).
items.construction: Finishing Works: Sourcing of CE-certified joinery, glazing, and structures adapted to modern building constraints.
items.inspection: Level II AQL Inspection: On-site technical factory validation with live video reports and mechanical resistance testing.

luxury.title: Luxury Packaging & Cosmetics
luxury.desc: Enhancing your products while guaranteeing an ethical and sustainable supply chain. We collaborate with luxury houses to transform packaging into a sensory experience.

items.premium: Premium Multi-materials: Lacquered wood boxes, brushed metal, rigid cardboard with high-fashion finishes (gilding, embossing).
items.cosmetic: Cosmetic Solutions: Glass bottling and airless pump systems guaranteeing the integrity of your formulas.
items.eco: Eco-responsible Sourcing: Integration of recycled (RPET) and bio-sourced materials (sugar cane fibers, bamboo).

tech.title: Electronics & High-Tech
tech.desc: Integration of critical components and final product assembly. We manage technological complexity while rigorously protecting your intellectual property.

items.sourcing: Component Sourcing: Supply of PCB boards, chips, and SMT/CMS assemblies even during global stock tensions.
items.compliance: Strict Compliance: Systematic RoHS, REACH certification and strict adherence to WEEE standards for secure market entry.
items.tests: Unit Testing: Implementation of functional unit testing protocols at the end of the production line for near-zero defect rates.

design.title: Furniture & Interior Design
design.desc: Supporting architects and hotel chains in the manufacture of custom furniture (FF&E). We transform your layout plans into tangible realities.

items.contract: Contract Standards: Manufacture of hospitality furniture meeting the requirements of resistance and durability for intensive use.
items.essences: Wood Management: Strict control of wood origin and compliance with environmental certifications (FSC, PEFC).
items.fire: Fireproofing: Treatment of foams and fabrics in accordance with fire safety standards (M1, BS 5852) for public establishments.

legal.title: Audit & Legal Safeguard
legal.desc: Because international sourcing is a risky business, we reinforce your contracts and supplier relations to guarantee the sustainability of your company.

items.contractual: Contractual Security: Drafting of exclusivity agreements and non-disclosure agreements (NDA) adapted to local jurisdictions.
items.financial: Financial Intelligence: Full audit of the financial health of factories to anticipate any risk of failure during production.
items.mediation: Mediation & Disputes: In case of issues, our local teams intervene immediately to negotiate and resolve disputes at the source.
